notes: **2026-09-02 (mechanical fix pass, post-review)** — (branch `feat/bug-registry`, PR #597; `scripts/campaign/bugs.mjs` + `scripts/campaign-check.mjs` + a new `scripts/campaign/normalize-evidence.mjs` + `.claude/hooks/stop.mjs` + SKILL.md, 14 commits, one per finding of a second refuter pass over the 7-lens review below) — **14 MORE DEFECTS CLOSED, LEDGER: `prove` now REQUIRES `--build-plan <path>` for a T3 row (resolved against the repo root, asserts the file's "## Manual verification" section carries the exact REG-id, persists `buildPlan`) — without it a T3 prove landed a claim campaign-check could never discharge; `move` now writes the destination shard BEFORE dropping the source (with an explicit `allowExistingIn` exception on `upsertLedgerRow`) and scans EVERY shard for a duplicate, not just `findShardOf`'s first hit — it used to drop the source on a refusal, destroying the authoritative row; `file` now writes the ledger row BEFORE the catalogue (id allocation is the union of catalogue + all shard ids) and restores the catalogue on any failure after — it used to write the catalogue first, so a refused concurrent write left a catalogue row describing a different bug than its own ledger row; campaign-check's T2 gate now falls back to a row's OWN `dischargeEvidence` when an existing web-e2e.json artifact has no hit for it (not just when the artifact is wholly absent) — a partial local Playwright run used to turn every OTHER already-discharged T2 row red; discharge's identical-evidence guard and campaign-check's shared-evidence warning now key on ONE normaliser (`normalize-evidence.mjs`: trim/collapse/lowercase) instead of raw vs `.trim()`'d comparisons; `writeRecord` now refreshes the header line itself on EVERY write (`reopen`/`prove`/`discharge`/`claim`/`release`/`tier` used to leave it stale until the next sync); `deferred` removed from campaign-check `VALID_STATES` (verified zero shards carried it — unrepresentable under one-row-per-id; `move` is the re-pointing operation). SYNC: the scan anchor is now returned by `commitMentions` and persisted by `cmds.sync` as its LAST statement, after every record has actually been written (was persisted BEFORE the per-record loop — a mid-run crash permanently lost events for bugs after the crash point, looking healthy); the two "an unscanned range" notes now go to stderr UNCONDITIONALLY regardless of `--quiet` (Gate 4's only mode), and stop.mjs's Gate 4 switched from `execSync`-based `sh()` to `spawnSync` so it can see stderr on a clean exit; `sync` now writes whenever the DERIVED front matter differs from the record's, not only when the body text does (a tier move never reached the record before); commit-subject hygiene — `appendHistory` strips `<!--`/`-->` from caller text (a poisoned commit subject pre-occupied a dedupe marker) and heals a hand-stripped marker instead of doubling the line; `git log` lines split on the FIRST tab only (a tabbed subject truncated); the "since the window" fallback no longer gets `.slice(0,8)`'d into "the wind". BRIEF/NEXT: brief's header counts WORKABLE rows (queued+regressed) with a `(N regressed)` breakdown and a regressed-batch banner + per-bug reopen citation (was "0 queued" hiding open work); `next --json` now emits `{next, alongside, eligible, waves, parked, skipped, cap, hubThreshold}` (was un-headed, no cap/hubThreshold); brief's "## Bugs" blocks now order by discovery.md's own `Ordering` backtick sequence when one exists, falling back to ledger order (new `BUGS_PIPELINE_DIR` override for testability); `liveClaim` returns `{unknown:true, why:"no board issue for this batch"}` instead of `null` for a batch with no board.json entry — `null` was indistinguishable from "checked, and free", so such a batch was silently offered with an uncompletable `claim <issue#>`. Every fix drives the REAL command (BUGS_ROOT/BUGS_SYNC_STATE/BUGS_PIPELINE_DIR seams + child-process refusal checks via `runCli`, now spawnable from a chdir'd throwaway git repo since `runCli` resolves its own script path via `import.meta.url` rather than `process.argv[1]`); self-test grew accordingly. || History in CHANGELOG.md (this directory). New sessions: add your note as a bullet at the top of CHANGELOG.md and REPLACE this field with it — never accumulate history here.
